critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1174 lines — consider splitting into modules (routes/models/services/seed) as backlog item. Not blocking.

OrderCreate uses default Pydantic behavior (extra fields silently ignored) so 'delivery_address' passed in body is dropped without error. Verified it is NOT persisted; acceptable but could be made explicit with `model_config = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')` if strict rejection is desired.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is a common anti-pattern — browsers ignore credentials with wildcard; consider tightening to explicit origins in prod.
Public /api/products response includes brand `stock` (via strip_brand_public) — matches product-card 'IN STOCK: N' UI; ensure product listing exposure is intentional.
